Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Pathologically confirmed diagnosis of IDH1(R132)-mutant acute myeloid leukemia (AML), myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) or chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML). IDH1 mutations could have been detected by any mutational technique at any prior point including at diagnosis or remission.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has metastatic hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, not AML, MDS, or CMML. No IDH1 mutation is mentioned.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Between the ages of 18 and 75 years
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is 47 years old, which falls within the specified age range.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Will undergo allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) for their malignancy. Conditioning may be either conventional myeloablative (MAC) or reduced intensity conditioning (RIC).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of the patient undergoing HSCT for breast cancer.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: HSCT Donor will be one of the following: - 5/6 or 6/6 (HLA-A, B, DR) matched related donor - 7/8 or 8/8 (HLA-A, B, DR, C) matched unrelated donor. Matching in the unrelated setting must be at the allele level. - Haploidentical related donor, defined as ≥ 3/6 (HLA-A, B, DR) matched --≥ 4/6 (HLA-A, B, DR) umbilical cord blood (UCB). Matching in the UCB setting is at the antigen level. Recipients may receive either one or two UCB units. In the case of 2 UCB units, both units must have been at least 4/6 matched with the recipient.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not undergoing HSCT, making this criterion irrelevant.
The patient's ECOG performance status is not provided in the data.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Participants must have normal organ and marrow function as defined below: - Absolute neutrophil count ≥ 1000/µL without growth factor support (e.g. GCSF) in the previous 7 days - Platelet count ≥ 50,000/µL without transfusional support in the previous 7 days - AST (SGOT), ALT (SGPT) and Alkaline phosphatase < 3x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) - Direct bilirubin < 2.0 mg/dL - Calculated creatinine clearance ≥ 40 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault formula) - LVEF must be equal to or greater than 40%, as measured by MUGA scan or echocardiogram
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's organ and marrow function.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Female patients of childbearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's pregnancy status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: The effects of ivosidenib on the developing human fetus are unknown. For this reason female participants of child-bearing potential and male participants must agree to use adequate contraception (hormonal or barrier method of birth control; abstinence) during the entire study treatment period and through 90 days after the last dose of treatment
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's use of contraception.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplants.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of the patient having undergone HSCT.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Evidence of relapsed/recurrent/residual disease as assessed by bone marrow aspirate and biopsy performed within 42 days prior to study entry.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's condition is metastatic breast cancer, not AML, MDS, or CMML, so this criterion is not applicable.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of other malignancy(ies) unless - the participant has been disease-free for at least 5 years and is deemed by the investigator to be at low risk of recurrence of that malignancy, or - the only prior malignancy was cervical cancer in situ and/or basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a history of breast cancer diagnosed at 45, which is less than 5 years ago.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Known diagnosis of active hepatitis B or hepatitis C
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of hepatitis B or C in the patient's data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Current or history of congestive heart failure New York Heart Association (NHYA) class 3 or 4, or any history of documented diastolic or systolic dysfunction (LVEF < 40%, as measured by MUGA scan or echocardiogram)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's heart function or history of heart failure.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Current or history of ventricular or life-threatening arrhythmias or diagnosis of long-QT syndrome
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's cardiac arrhythmias or QT interval.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: QTc interval (i.e., Friderica's correction [QTcF]) ≥ 450 ms or other factors that increase the risk of QT prolongation or arrhythmic events (e.g., heart failure, hypokalemia, family history of long QT interval syndrome) at screening
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's QTc interval or related risk factors.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Systemic infection requiring IV antibiotic therapy within 7 days preceding the first dose of study drug, or other severe infection
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of a systemic infection in the patient's data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Uncontrolled intercurrent illness that would limit compliance with study requirements.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about any uncontrolled intercurrent illness.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: HIV-positive participants on combination antiretroviral therapy are ineligible because of the potential for pharmacokinetic interactions with study drug. In addition, these participants are at increased risk of lethal infections when treated with marrow-suppressive therapy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of HIV status in the patient's data.

Recap: The patient does not meet the primary inclusion criterion of having an IDH1(R132)-mutant AML, MDS, or CMML diagnosis. Additionally, the patient has a history of breast cancer diagnosed less than 5 years ago, violating the exclusion criteria. Other criteria remain unclear due to insufficient data.
